venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Friday 9/25 (MOD & Chef KE / JMS; nice all around).** Net $11,199 vs target $10,833 (+3.4%). Food $328, event sales $1,559. Comps $54.30 / 0.5%. 332 guests at $29.04 check average. A decent Friday night — the film festival crowd arrived a bit later than expected, around 9pm, but filled out the room nicely for guests and staff alike. Dolly night was a hit: staff wore pink, the DJ mixed in Dolly and other country music, and several guests came dressed in Dolly gear and wigs. Kitchen smooth sailing. Film Festival group was pleasant throughout and had their tab voided as a courtesy. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: the whole room singing along when Jolene inevitably played. Entered by BT.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Friday 9/25 (AM Maggie & Josh; PM Carey & Lucas; rainy).** Net incl. events $21,959.01 vs target $17,070 (+28.6%). Outlet net $13,451.01 (DC/AM $1,305.91, D&C PM $12,076.09; Garden/6A n/a). Event sales $8,508 (event food $5,112). Food incl. events $8,253.80. Comps $560.50 / 4.19%. 349 guests (Tock). Busier early than late; ran 3 servers and 1 host, rain kept guests in and the waitlist never got long. Coffee bar had a strong finish with the wedding party ordering Golden Ratios. Event: engagement party for Savannah & Tyler, 68 guests 6–9pm in the Garden — heavy rain during setup cleared as it started; taco bar and sliders from Lucas & Rachael; Justice, Mike and Jake crushed service and the couple thanked the team. Kitchen steady. No incidents; no-shows charged. Favorite moment: investor Benjamin keen on starting a Whiskey Club in the space — Carey to follow up with EF & MS. Entered by Carey.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Friday 9/25 (MOD & Chef Gigi, Julian, Joe, Angel, Saleh).** Net $11,008 vs target $11,412 (-3.5%). Marquee $8,146, Standing Room $2,862. Food $1,431. Comps $337 — F&F, industry, investors, DNL. 302 guests; check average shown as net/guests ($36.45) — the form reported $84.68, which appears to be per-check rather than per-guest. Unusually slow start on 91 booked covers, giving time for side work; reservations concentrated 8–10pm, when both bars filled and a waitlist of large parties built. Smooth flow that never felt overwhelming; Mia back on the floor and crushing it alongside Jaz. Both rooms stayed full until midnight, strong last call, smooth close. Maintenance: water not coming out very cold — Julio contacted. No incidents; no-shows charged. Favorite moment: seeing Mia back on the floor. Entered by Joe.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Friday 9/25 (MOD Marcus / Josh; beautiful weather).** Net incl. events $10,927.72 vs target $8,524 (+28.2%). Marquee bar $8,113.34, Garden $3,057 (total sales $11,170.34). Food $1,085. Comps $242.62, voids $52. 220 guests. Busy Garden night from 6:30pm with 2/3-tops and larger groups ordering multiple rounds, plenty referred by The Dabney; hit a waitlist but moved guests inside efficiently; last call 11:45pm. Takeaway: food pacing to the Garden — servers should run Garden tickets immediately, especially quick items like chips and dip. Marquee built hour by hour with walk-ins, reservations and old friends; Garden used as overflow; bar top full all night, team used the compendium for 86 substitutions. Focus areas: water service, running food to the Garden, clearing the KDS, working to completion. Best Friday push in several weeks. Kitchen: Chef ran the line solo; crudo, tartare and bread & butter (the star) led; a few comps for overcooked dishes, portions and ticket times — an extra set of hands is now scheduled for Fri/Sat. Form's date field reads 9/26 but day-of-week Friday and post time (5:40am ET 9/26) place it on 9/25. Maintenance: curtain, service tin rinser. No incidents; no-shows charged. Favorite moment: Owen's stage. Entered by Josh.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.weather: Cloudy morning, sunny and temperate day
venues.narrative: **MG — Friday 9/25 (AM Franck & Shannon; PM Justin & Shannon/Marcus; cloudy morning, sunny and temperate day).** Total net sales $14,465 vs target $4,387 (+229.7%). Municipal Bar morning $1,837, evening $8,685, Sun Club $37, Hot Eye $2,896. No food or event sales recorded. Comps $216. 263 guests (22 morning + 241 evening, OpenTable). Good start right at 8am with hotel guest groups, then quiet until 11, with a few larger tours and steady walk-ins through the afternoon. Evening was busy all night — a Dolly Parton tribute screening next door brought a wave of guests before and after, reservations were strong, and walk-ins were up as (false?) fall weather set in; the bar ran three bartenders and a server short but the floor team covered smoothly, with the whole bar full from 6 until close. Sun Club had a really good day with strong food and drink sales. Hot Eye was packed at 8pm; Brother Vinyl started their set early to a full room, a short lull around 10:30 for reset before filling back up until midnight, with a killer set and phenomenal energy. Kitchen busy, running low on strips and tartare, expecting a heavy prep day; happy heading into busy season. Maintenance: Hot Eye's back bar lights stopped working. No incidents. Favorite moment: Dolly wigs and sequins everywhere in tribute, plus a regular stopping by with friends and a guest showing off the space to new friends. Entered by Alexis.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.weather: Started rainy, then cleared up with low 60s
venues.narrative: **SEA — Friday 9/25 (MOD Curtis Hayes; rainy start, clearing to low 60s).** Net $11,914 vs target $10,000 (+19.1%). Food $1,921, no event sales. Comps $418.31 / 3.4%, mostly shifties. 235 guests at $48.43 average spend. Rain hampered early walk-ins until it cleared around 6:45–7pm; a Mariners game brought a small sports bump. Kitchen got rocked with nearly $2K in food — if the trend holds, two cooks will be needed for service. Floor energy a bit sleepy but good vibes; bar cranked with a small pinch at the service well 11:15–11:30 around last call. Whole bar yelled happy birthday to Belle before midnight. Playlists: LA Soul, Funk Slappers, LA R&B Mid, LA Hip Hop Late. Kitchen: Sfian and Josh held it down doing $1,900+. Maintenance: kitchen dishwasher plunger broken again (Autochlor emailed); bar freezer repair not until Monday. Low: Uwajima Gimlet (1 gallon reserved for tomorrow's party). No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: making Belle blush. Entered by Curtis Hayes.
